sources.entry: Pastefy - Beautiful, simple and easy to deploy Pastebin with optional client encryption, multitab pastes, an API, a highlighted editor and more. (Source Code, Clients) MIT Docker/K8S/Java

summary.one_liner: Pastefy is a self-hostable, open source pastebin and Gist alternative for sharing and saving code snippets, with a Java backend and a web frontend.
summary.what_it_does: Pastefy lets users paste and share text or code, with raw view, copy button, and fork options. It includes an API with documented clients for JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, and Go, plus a curl upload command. Logged-in users can organize pastes into folders, view and delete their own pastes. It renders previews for several file types, including Markdown, Mermaid, SVG, CSV, GeoJSON, diff, iCalendar (.ics), regex, and Asciinema recordings (.cast). Login can be configured through INTERAAPPS, Google, GitHub, Discord, Twitch, or a custom OIDC provider. The README also describes VS Code and Raycast extensions and an asciinema upload integration.
use_cases: upload files from the command line with curl
how_to_run: cd pastefy/frontend && npm run install && npm run build
notable: Previews for many formats including Mermaid, GeoJSON, SVG, and Asciinema .cast files
Multiple OAuth2 providers can be enabled at once, including a custom OIDC option
API clients for JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, and Go
Asciinema upload integration for terminal recordings
Supports Docker, Docker Compose, and container-less deployment
caveats: Admin role requires manually editing the type field to ADMIN in the MySQL pastefy_users table
Building from source needs both Node.js/npm and Maven; the README does not describe a hosted setup beyond the public instance
Configuration details are split out to external docs not included in the README
